name: Slovene with Slavko
title: Slovene with Slavko
character: Slavko, a warm, curious dragon who is the learner's companion through the course — he speaks Slovene to them from the first second and is unmistakably on their side
setup: A brand-new learner's first contact with the language. Slavko meets them, tells them who he is, and wants to know who they are — the name exchange is the one thing he can genuinely want from someone who owns no words at all.
